crew.overview: The ultimate wish-fulfillment tale of a teenage Gran Turismo player whose gaming skills won him a series of Nissan competitions to become an actual professional racecar driver.
crew.title: Gran Turismo

crew.overview: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD blade runner who has been missing for 30 years.
crew.title: Blade Runner 2049

details.biography:
Balázs Lengyel is known for Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning Part One (2023), Black Widow (2021) and Atomic Blonde (2017).

Balázs Lengyel is a Budapest based writer-director. Having studied film at the the University of Budapest, Binger Filmlab in Amsterdam, and the London Film Academy, he’s worked as a screenwriter on numerous feature films like Coyote (2017), Ravine (2021) and TV drama series like the award winning Golden Life at HBO Europe.  His most recent credits as a screenwriter include "3000 numbered pieces" a feature directed by Ádám Császi, "Balaton Brigade" a series project that won the Berlinale Co-Pro Series pitch in 2021, and Hunyadi - Rise of the Raven, co-produced by Germany’s Beta Film. As a director his debut feature was Lajkó - gypsy in space, a historical comedy drama that premiered in Warsaw IFF and won the audience award in Trieste S+F Festival. In 2020 he created Narra, a development hub and production company that specializes in arthouse films, drama series and genre bending projects.
details.name: Balázs Lengyel
